title: remote_input
description: Panel message forwarded to the agent; the one server-to-agent message that carries `type` instead of `action`. Sent on the Vision channel when it is open, otherwise on the command channel. Two kinds: a preview or stream command in `action` (get_thumbnail from the panel's preview grid, set_fps), and mouse/keyboard input in `input_type`, which the server forwards only for an administrator holding an open session on the device. Messages from the panel socket are forwarded as the panel sent them; POST /api/remote_input forwards only the fields listed here, and only scalars of at most 64 characters; neither path checks the types, so an agent must drop an event with a wrong type. The agent ignores a message whose `device` is not its own ID and refuses (`capability_denied`) when Vision is off or, for input, no session is approved. The panel socket path also gates a legacy `"action": "execute"` (open session and the terminal module required), but no agent acts on it and it is not part of the protocol.

action.description: get_thumbnail: send a screen preview (on the command channel a `thumbnail`; on the Vision channel the Windows agent's answer is the next `stream_frame`). set_fps: change the frame rate of a running stream to `fps`.

x.description: mouse_move: horizontal position in screen pixels (the panel converts from the scaled frame). While a Vision v2 stream runs: pixels of the shown output, that is the selected screen or the side-by-side image of all screens (the frames' coordinate space); the agent maps them to the physical screen.

y.description: mouse_move: vertical position in screen pixels (Vision v2: as for x).

is_down.description: mouse_click and keyboard: true = press, false = release.

delta.description: mouse_wheel: wheel delta (the panel sends 120 or -120).

key.description: keyboard: KeyboardEvent.key (a character or a named key).
